title: THE GOLDEN SCOOTER’S ULTIMATE TRUTH! 🛴
topic: The mystery of the stolen scooter is finally solved with a heartwarming twist.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: EVERYONE SHUT UP [beat] BECAUSE NIX JUST GAVE THE ENTIRE NEIGHBORHOOD’S MOST EXPENSIVE SCOOTER TO THE KID WHO BULLIES HIM EVERY SINGLE DAY!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I knew you were a loser Nix [beat] but handing over a thousand dollars worth of gold-plated metal is just beyond [beat] absolute stupidity!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You think it is all about the money [beat] but while you were counting your imaginary profits [beat] I was busy making sure a family stayed afloat.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Wait a minute [beat] are you telling me that this entire time the stolen property was actually a secret donation [beat] to a family in a major crisis?

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: My mom lost her car and her job [beat] and Nix saw me crying behind the gym and just handed me the keys [beat] without asking for a single cent!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: That is the most ridiculous story I have ever heard [beat] and I bet Nix is just hiding the cash [beat] in his dirty gym locker right now!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Check every locker you want [beat] but you will only find old socks and the realization that you have never done [beat] a selfless thing in your life!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: He didn't just give me a ride [beat] he gave me a reason to stop being a jerk to everyone [beat] and that is worth way more than some shiny paint!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: In all my years as a principal [beat] I have never seen a student use such a valuable item [beat] to settle a debt of hatred with an act of grace.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The scooter is gone [beat] but Bruno isn’t a bully anymore and the school records are finally wiped clean [beat] of all our past mistakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: AND THAT IS HOW NIX PROVED [beat] THAT IN THIS WORLD KINDNESS IS THE ONLY CURRENCY THAT ACTUALLY BUYS YOU A COMPLETELY CLEAN SLATE!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Now if someone could please help me find my old bike [beat] because walking home in these shoes [beat] is starting to feel like a real punishment!
